title: Add and Remove Elements From Queue

blocks.content: Add and Remove Elements From Queue
In this section, we will look at the following functions:

items: push() - inserts an element to the rear of the queue
pop() - removes an element from the front of the queue

blocks.content: Here, we have used the push() function to insert elements to the rear of the queue:
After this operation, the numbers queue will consist of the elements 1, 2, and 3.
Then, we have removed one element from the front of the queue using the pop() function
This will remove the first element that we inserted to the queue i.e. 1.
